parsed.note_claim: The bystander who disarmed the gunman in the Bondi Beach shooting is Ahmed al Ahmed.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ahmed al Ahmed, the hero bystander who tackled and disarmed one of the Bondi shooters on Sunday, has said that despite the immense pain he is in, he does not regret lunging at the gunman.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly identifies the bystander who tackled and disarmed the gunman as Ahmed al Ahmed in the headline and opening paragraph.
